data.name: Moon Lake Town
data.detailed_description:
“Moonlight, soil, and fresh starts. For those who need a soft place to land.”-

🌙 Welcome to Moon Lake Town

Come as you are, and stay for as long as you need.

You arrive with nothing but a quiet pull back to nature, something calling you home, a quiet feeling that you’re meant to be here. You find yourself taking residence on an overgrown piece of land, starting fresh among colorful strangers and gentle routines.

Moon Lake Town isn’t about rushing, escaping or completing. It’s about breathing again. About remembering what it feels like to belong to the earth, to yourself, and maybe, in time, to others.

Realistically, nothing comes for free. You’ll need to work with your hands, tend the soil, and slowly pay off the land you now call home. But in the process, you might find something far more valuable than gold, a reason to keep growing.

And as you grow, so does the town. The people here respond to your warmth, your distance, and the choices you make.🌾✨

🌙 Things to do:

💞 Make friends, share moments, and grow alongside the people of Moon Lake Town, each with their own rhythm, quirks, and dreams. Watch them go about their days, reveal their hearts through small gestures, and open up in quiet, meaningful ways.

🌸 Strengthen bonds and brighten the town, help ease tensions and contribute to seasonal festivals, bringing warmth and renewal to the community.

🌱 Tend your land and watch the seasons change as you grow fruits, crops, and flowers.

🎣 Fish by the lake, the rivers, or the ocean, or simply spend a slow afternoon by the pond.

🌲 Explore the forest and mines, uncovering forgotten places once loved and left behind.

🐾 Tame and raise wild creatures, building trust and companionship through patience, consistency, and gentle care.

⚔️ Challenge yourself in the mines, battle creatures, grow stronger, and refine your weapons and armor as you venture deeper.

🛠️ Craft and cook with ingredients and materials you’ve gathered, grown, or been given.

📚 Learn and grow at the local college, master skills in Science, Botany, Pet Taming, Mining, Fishing, and Cooking, while discovering new species of flowers, pets, and recipes along the way.

👗 Express yourself through dress-up, finding joy in the little details that make you, you.

🏡 Build and decorate your home, gathering materials and resources to build a cozy space you can truly call your own.

data.short_description: Moon Lake Town is a life-sim that cares more about who you become than what you produce. Slow down, reconnect with nature, and rediscover joy. Farm, fish, explore, gather, learn, craft, build, and create at your own pace. Every day is a chance to grow — and begin again. 🌙

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or modern integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
